preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 10**6 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each number ai on the vertices must be between 1 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: There must be exactly n-1 edges connecting the vertices, and each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum difference between the maximum and minimum values on any simple path in the tree.
